title: One Tuesday, Twice
description: Run a fictional 18-person service company through the same modeled day twice, then test six workflow changes against the same demand.
seoDescription: An interactive project that models one difficult day at a fictional service company, then runs the same demand through a redesigned system.
problem: Service businesses can outgrow an informal workflow before they outgrow their headcount. The strain shows up as re-keying, chasing updates, missed requests, and apologies to customers.
solution: A written walkthrough with an optional simulation: experience the old workflow, add six changes one at a time, then compare both workflows against the same modeled demand.
result: A deterministic comparison that makes coordination time, missed requests, and carried work visible while keeping every model assumption inspectable.
